summary:
[  edit  ]
The Panel Execute  DAT  will run its script when the  Panel Values  of a specified panel component changes. You can specify which panel values to monitor, and trigger scripts based on their values changing in various ways.
Panel Execute DATs are created with  default python method  placeholders. For each monitored condition in the parameters, there is a matching python method in the  DAT . When a condition is turned on in the parameters, each time that condition is satisfied the corresponding python method will be executed.
In the template Python script,  panelValue  is passed to each method, and you can query each call by printing  panelValue.name  and  panelValue.val . See  PanelValue Class .

parameters.label: Panels
parameters.name: panels
parameters.description: Select which  Panel COMPs  to monitor for changes.

parameters.label: Panel Value
parameters.name: panelvalue
parameters.description: The  Panel Value (s) that is monitored to trigger the execution of the script.

parameters.label: Off to On
parameters.name: offtoon
parameters.description: The onOffToOn() method executes when the panel value specified switches from off to on, called at the first "on" frame.

parameters.label: While On
parameters.name: whileon
parameters.description: The whileOn() method executes when the panel value specified is on. It is called once each frame.

parameters.label: On to Off
parameters.name: ontooff
parameters.description: The onOnToOff() method executes when the panel value specified switches from on to off, called at the first "off" frame.

parameters.label: While Off
parameters.name: whileoff
parameters.description: The whileOff() method executes when the panel value specified is off. It is called once each frame.

parameters.label: Value Change
parameters.name: valuechange
parameters.description: The onValueChange() method executes when the panel value specified changes value in any way. It is called once each frame.

parameters.label: Edit..
parameters.name: edit
parameters.description: Clicking this opens a text editor to edit text in the  DAT .

parameters.label: File
parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The filesystem path and name of the file to load. Accepts  .txt  and  .dat  files.

parameters.label: Sync to File
parameters.name: syncfile
parameters.description: When On, loads the file from disk into the  DAT  when the projects starts.  A filename must be specified.  Turning on the option will load the file from disk immediately.  If the file does not exist, it will be created the first time the  DAT  is updated.  The file is monitored so that any changes made to the file will update the  DAT , and any changes made to the  DAT  will be written to the file right away.  If the file is removed, the  DAT  will retain its current contents.

parameters.label: Load on Start
parameters.name: loadonstart
parameters.description: When On, reloads the file from disk into the  DAT  when the projects starts.

parameters.label: Load File

parameters.label: Write on Toe Save

parameters.label: Write File
